title: The Painting's Warning
description: A dimly lit, grimy wooden desk holds an open drawer containing a lit flashlight, two keys, and a handwritten note. Behind it, four old CRT televisions display eerie, empty institutional hallways, one showing a dark silhouetted figure and another labeled 'Failure 4'.
prompt: A gritty wooden desk in a dark abandoned room with an open drawer revealing a black flashlight, brass keys, and a note that reads 'If the painting speaks, do not follow alone'. Four old CRT televisions sit on the desk displaying eerie empty hallways and institutional corridors, one with a dark silhouetted figure standing in the center, another labeled Failure 4, moody cinematic lighting with a single warm desk lamp, dusty and unsettling atmosphere
